walkthrough_missions.title: Behind Enemy Lines
walkthrough_missions.guide: Sabotage the dam, destroy the Flak AA installations, and exfiltrate across the perimeter bridge.

walkthrough_missions.title: Dead Drop
walkthrough_missions.guide: Infiltrate the town, locate the mole inside the cafe, search the municipal library, and destroy the Gestapo depot.

walkthrough_missions.title: Sonderzüge Sabotage
walkthrough_missions.guide: Raid the Hotel Terminus, destroy the Sonderzüge armored supply trains, and sever the railyard switching network.

walkthrough_missions.title: Collision Course
walkthrough_missions.guide: Locate Site D coordinates, plant satchels across the structural supports, and extract via the cableway.

walkthrough_missions.title: Devil's Cauldron
walkthrough_missions.guide: Infiltrate the subterranean facility, execute scuttle orders to cease Kleine Blume production, and sabotage ingredient transports.

walkthrough_missions.title: Assault on Fort Rouge
walkthrough_missions.guide: Breach the lower gate fortifications, disable the coastal defense battery, and exfiltrate prior to Allied aerial bombardment.

walkthrough_missions.title: Lock, Stock and Barrels
walkthrough_missions.guide: Penetrate the testing tunnels, sabotage liquid fuel reservoirs, and neutralize the operational Zugwerfer launch unit.

walkthrough_missions.title: End of the Line
walkthrough_missions.guide: Prevent the final Zugwerfer deployment heading toward the Normandy beaches and destroy the patrol panzer tank.

walkthrough_missions.title: All or Nothing
walkthrough_missions.guide: Climactic final encounter. Infiltrate the command center, eliminate Colonel Kruger, and dismantle the superweapon apparatus.

walkthrough_missions.title: Target Führer: Lights, Camera, ACHTUNG!
walkthrough_missions.guide: Infiltrate the movie set estate, identify the real Führer among his doubles, eliminate Hitler, and exfiltrate undetected.
